title: On a lemma of Littlewood and Offord on the distribution of certain sums
author: Daniel J. Kleitman

publication.received_authority: Original printed page 259 explicitly says Received November 19, 1964.

version: Scan of the original published article with archive cover retained exactly
metadata_qualification: The IIIF language label is German, contrary to the actual English article. Archive digitization in 2002 and PDF creation in 2020 are not distinct mathematical versions.
proof_coverage: Complete plane chain and finite open-disc transfer. The higher-dimensional orthant argument, Lemmas III/IV and Theorem III remain at explicit lesser proof scope.
boundary_conventions: Strict coefficient norms > 1 with a closed unit disc; norms >= 1 with an open unit disc only. Counts sign choices with multiplicity.
